items.description: Meat World Wonderboom is part of the Meat World butchery chain, which has been trading since 1995 and has grown into one of South Africa's largest butchery groups. From its branch in Lavender Centre, Wonderboom, serving the Annlin West area, the store's butchers cut, pack and price meat products in-house for customer convenience, supplying fresh lamb, beef, pork and chicken alongside pre-packed and processed meat lines. The business emphasises quality-controlled products and abides by international health and safety standards to keep its meat hygienic and food-safe. Meat World also runs ongoing weekly specials and in-store competitions, including a recurring cash prize draw for customers who spend a set amount in-store, along with recipe ideas for customers looking for inspiration. Being based in the Lavender Centre gives the Wonderboom branch convenient reach for residents and businesses across Annlin West and the wider Wonderboom area needing a reliable source of fresh and processed meat.

Minuteman Press Montana operates from the first floor of Palms Centre in Magalieskruin as a local printing and copying centre serving the surrounding Pretoria communities. The business specialises in full-colour printing and copying alongside graphic design and finishing services, and produces high-quality colour copies and digital prints in-house. Customers can shop ready-made desserts such as cupcakes, brownies, cookies, mini cakes and dessert trays directly in-store, or arrange a wedding cake, with prices starting from R3,500, by booking a tasting and working with a consultant to finalise the design. For birthdays and other occasions, customers can build a themed cake by choosing a size, sponge, filling and decor style and confirming the order with the sales team. Collection is available from the shop, with delivery offered across Gauteng, and instant online pricing lets customers get a sense of cost before placing an order.

Nel Accountants Incorporated supports small businesses in Pretoria with a full back-office accounting service, covering everything from company registration through to annual financial statements.
